# Engine tests left out of the headless suite (tools/headless_tests.py) because they still need the
# vendored app/ or TandemApp's packages (ENG-413 WP12). Measured on the box: each failed in a tree
# without app/ with the reason given (20261115T012237Z-eng413-wp13-hdiag2). Since WP13 the server
# imports and serves without TandemApp, so what is left runs TandemApp's own code: its conductor, its
# extension, its proxy or its files. One file a line, the reason after a #. WP14 empties this list.
# The three guards that read app/ by design come first.
tests/test_app_hook.py  # the no-app guard: while VENDORED_APP is True it asserts app/ and app.pin are here (WP14 flips it)
tests/test_app_pin.py  # hashes app/ against app.pin (WP14 removes both)
tests/test_engine_api_contract.py  # reverse-deps.json is the inventory of the engine's reach into app/; reads app/ files (WP14 empties it)
tests/test_auth.py  # checks the session answer against TandemApp's dashboard-v1 session schema (tests/dash_contract.py PAGE)
tests/test_callrepair.py  # two cases run the conductor's call repair (tandemapp)
tests/test_eng413_baseline.py  # the fixtures' fake engine runs QSE_EXT=tandemapp.engine_ext
tests/test_engine_only.py  # starts chat mode, QSE_EXT=tandemapp.engine_ext
tests/test_engine_routes.py  # case 5 starts chat mode (QSE_EXT=tandemapp.engine_ext) for both paths
tests/test_floor_wait.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_fp_equivalents.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_handler_timeout.py  # tests the /v1/chat-app forward, TandemApp's tandemapp.chat_forward
tests/test_kvpool_admission.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_memory_wait.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_reasoning_effort_off.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_regenerate.py  # runs app/tandemapp/conductor/fake_decider.py
tests/test_replica_identity.py  # one case starts --backends, TandemApp's proxy in the engine's process
tests/test_resident_park.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_roles_dynamic.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_router_question_burst.py  # one case starts a fake engine in chat mode (QSE_EXT=tandemapp.engine_ext)
tests/test_setup_wren.py  # asserts Wren's extra knowledge, TandemApp's app/packages and app/docs/proxy.md, is in the repository
tests/test_side_lane.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_slot0_wait.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_slot_affinity.py  # imports TandemApp (tandemapp) in a test module it uses
tests/test_think_off.py  # test_the_server imports TandemApp (tandemapp)
